title: Digital Storage
description:
AE2 can store stuff digitally on storage cells. These have a byte limit (roughly corresponds to how many items can be stored in a cell, a byte stores 8 items) and a type limit (how many §odifferent§r item types can be stored). Even a 256k item storage cell will be fully filled with 63 iron axes of different damage values! (fresh iron axes will stack though - AE2 doesn't care about the item's stack size limit).
Cells are made from the Cell Housing, which sets the type of storage (item, fluid, etc.), and a Storage Component, which sets the byte limit.
For the system to read from storage cells, they must be placed into a connected ME Drive.
Cells can be formatted in the Cell Workbench to filter what items they accept.
